name: animator
short: A2A pixel-art rendering agent backed by pixel-art-mcp.
description: An A2A-only agent that models and renders pixel-art sprites and animations via the pixel-art-mcp server, and delivers the resulting Discord-ready assets (pixel-agents.zip, preview.gif or preview.png) as real attachments.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends the A2A task text it receives (written by pico from Discord conversations) to corridor's configured LLM endpoint, and the LLM's tool arguments to the pixel-art-mcp server registered through telephonepole; it does not store either. Finished renders are posted to Discord as attachments. It stores no data about Discord users: only bot-owner prompt, tool-budget, logging and timeout settings.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Outside services: A2A task text and rendered images go to corridor's LLM endpoint, and its tools call the pixel-art-mcp server, whose output files it downloads and attaches in Discord. Setup: run pixel-art-mcp yourself, load telephonepole, then [p]telephonepole add pixel-art <url> and [p]telephonepole agents pixel-art to grant animator access. Also configure [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model and [p]corridor a2a host/port.
author: NNTin
